title: Developer Advocate - Service Management
US Accounting & Project Management Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Working Hours: US Central Time (CST/CDT)

Experience: 5+ years working with US-based clients (required)



About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and self-driven US Accounting & Project Management Specialist to support our US-based clients, primarily in the healthcare industry.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in US accounting practices, bookkeeping, financial reporting, billing, and financial modeling, combined with excellent project management and organizational skills.

This role requires someone who can independently manage multiple client accounts and projects, prioritize deadlines, resolve accounting discrepancies, and deliver accurate financial reports without constant supervision or hand-holding.

We need someone who takes ownership, works proactively, and ensures tasks and projects are completed accurately and on time.



Key Responsibilities

1. US Accounting & Financial Operations

• Manage day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for multiple US-based clients..

• Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, invoicing, and financial recordkeeping..

• Prepare and review financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports..

• Support monthly financial close processes and ensure timely reconciliation of accounts..

• Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies while maintaining accurate financial records..

• Ensure accounting activities align with US accounting standards and client requirements..



2. Financial Modeling & Reporting

• Create, maintain, and update financial models using advanced Google Sheets functions..

• Analyze client financial data and prepare monthly financial reports..

• Develop dashboards, pivot tables, and financial summaries to support business decisions..

• Reproduce and organize client financial information accurately..



3. Project Management & Independent Execution

• Independently manage multiple client accounting projects and deliverables simultaneously..

• Plan workflows, prioritize competing tasks, and ensure deadlines are consistently met..

• Track project milestones, maintain accountability, and provide proactive progress updates..

• Identify operational challenges and resolve problems without waiting for detailed instructions..

• Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure smooth execution..

• Take full ownership of assigned projects from start to completion with minimal supervision..



4. Client Communication & Financial Presentations

• Communicate directly with US-based clients through phone calls,
s, and virtual meetings..

• Present monthly financial reports and explain financial performance clearly..

• Respond professionally to client inquiries and proactively follow up on outstanding items..

• Maintain strong client relationships through timely communication and reliable service delivery..



5. Billing, Invoicing & Reconciliation

• Oversee outsourced healthcare billing and invoicing processes..

• Track payments, outstanding invoices, and billing discrepancies..

• Reconcile financial transactions and ensure accurate documentation..

• Coordinate with billing teams to ensure financial information is complete and up to date..



6. Notion & Workflow Management

• Use Notion to manage client projects, accounting workflows, deadlines, and deliverables..

• Maintain organized documentation, project trackers, and task updates..

• Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows and operational efficiency..



Required Qualifications

• 5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience supporting US-based clients..

• Strong understanding of US accounting principles, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes..

• Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar US accounting software..

• Advanced Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, dashboards, and financial modeling..

• Proven ability to independently manage multiple client accounts and projects..

• Strong project management, prioritization, and time-management skills..

• Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, and month-end close..

• Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with US clients..

• Proficiency in Notion for project tracking and documentation..

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities..

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and consistently meet deadlines..

• Minimum 90% Upwork client satisfaction rate for applicants with an Upwork profile..

• Degree from a top 20 university in the candidate's home country is highly preferred..



Additional Requirements

• Availability during US Central Time business hours..

• Reliable high-speed internet connection..

• Experience working with multiple US clients simultaneously..

• Strong sense of accountability, initiative, and ownership..

• Ability to anticipate challenges and propose solutions independently..

• Experience in US healthcare accounting is an added advantage..



What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in someone who:

• Understands US accounting: Can independently handle bookkeeping, reconciliations, reporting, and accounting operations..

• Manages multiple projects: Can balance several client accounts, deadlines, and deliverables effectively..

• Requires minimal supervision: Takes initiative, solves problems, and completes assignments without constant follow-up..

• Communicates confidently: Can speak directly with US clients and present financial information professionally..

• Takes full ownership: Is accountable for accuracy, deadlines, and the successful completion of assigned work..



How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their most up-to-date resume, highlighting their US accounting experience, QuickBooks and Google Sheets proficiency, project management capabilities, and experience supporting US-based clients.

title: Virtual Assistant, Operations & Scheduling
description:
About Bestie



Bestie is a concierge-style pet care company serving Downtown Manhattan. We provide dog walks, drop-ins, daycare, boarding, and house sitting for dogs and cats. Members pay a monthly membership fee and get access to a dedicated concierge team, so they never have to scramble to find someone they trust with their pet. Behind the scenes, a lot of coordination happens. We have 170+ members, 150+ independent contractors who make up our sitter team, and a calendar that changes every day.



The Role



Bestie is growing, and we're adding a second virtual assistant to our operations team. We already have an Executive Assistant who runs our day-to-day operations. You'll work closely with them, take on the behind-the-scenes admin work, and act as their backup so nothing slips through the cracks when things get busy.



At first, your focus will be backend operations: scheduling, booking entry, records, billing checks, responding to
 inquiries, tracking leads, and supporting the Executive Assistant we already have. You won't be handling our concierge phone line at the start. This role suits someone who enjoys owning systems, catches small discrepancies before they become problems, and works well as part of a team.



As you grow into the role, there's also an opportunity to work directly with our members and sitter team and help run our day-to-day concierge line. This isn't the focus at the start, but if you enjoy customer service and relationship management, there's room to grow in that direction as part of a full time role.



Part-Time to Full-Time

The role starts at 20–25 hours per week, with the goal of transitioning to full-time after approximately two months for the right candidate, based on performance and business needs.



Training

You'll get a structured onboarding period during November and December. The training includes:

- Studying our operations handbook

- Shadowing sessions with our current EA

- Handling tasks on your own, then reviewing them together until you're confident



What You'll Do



Scheduling

- Enter each week's confirmed bookings into Time To Pet (a comprehensive, all-in-one pet care management software) and flag any double bookings to the team

- Help schedule recurring and upcoming bookings and keep our sitter availability tracker current





 & lead management

- Respond to new member inquiries by
 and through our website

- Track every lead in our Lead Tracker so no inquiry goes unanswered



Billing, payroll & records

- Help make sure members are charged correctly through Time To Pet

- Double-check invoices before weekly billing runs

- Log bookings in our master Excel tracker



Onboarding

- Members: Set up new member profiles in Time To Pet, create care instruction docs, and update member records

- Sitters: Support the full sitter onboarding process, including profile setup, documentation, availability, and payroll information



What Success Looks Like

- Bookings are entered accurately and on time

- Time To Pet, Google Calendar, and our internal trackers stay in sync

- Double bookings and scheduling conflicts are caught before they become problems

- Member and sitter records are complete and up to date

- Billing discrepancies are identified before invoices are sent

- Every inquiry and lead is tracked and receives a timely response

- You communicate proactively when something is unclear or at risk of being missed



What This Role Is Not

- This is not a personal assistant role.

- You will not be managing the founder's personal schedule or errands.

- You will not be responsible for sales or social media.

- You will not initially be responsible for answering the concierge phone line.



Tools You'll Use

- Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail), Excel, Time To Pet, WhatsApp, Quo

- Experience with Time To Pet or similar booking software is a plus, but we'll train you on our systems.



Who You Are

- At least 3 years of experience as a virtual assistant, executive assistant, or in an admin or operations role, ideally supporting a US-based or services business

- Highly organized and detail-oriented. You notice when a calendar entry, invoice, and spreadsheet don't match, and you fix it.

- Strong written English. You communicate clearly and warmly with members and teammates.

- A good collaborator who keeps your teammate in the loop and is comfortable sharing ownership of systems

- Able to work independently. You won't always have someone available to answer a question immediately. You should be comfortable assessing a situation, checking our existing processes/documentation, and escalating when a decision is needed

- Proactive. You spot problems before anyone asks and bring solutions along with them.

- Trustworthy with sensitive information, including payroll

- Comfortable with multiple systems and quick to learn new tools

- Available to work hours that overlap with US Eastern Time, including Sundays

- Timely and collaborative in team communication, staying actively engaged and responsive during scheduled working hours

- Flags urgent booking or sitter issues immediately

- Eager to clarify details to ensure high-quality support; Asks questions when information is unclear rather than making assumptions



Nice to have: Experience in pet care, hospitality, or client-facing service businesses, and a genuine love of dogs and cats.



Details

Compensation: $6.00-$7.00/hour

Schedule: 20–25 hours/week, including a required Sunday shift during US Eastern Time. Exact schedule will be established during onboarding based on business needs. 

Start date: Training begins early November



How to Apply

Apply through our application form: h t t p s : / / f o r m s . g l e / Y 4 u B S k Q H B P p h i B G n 9 

(remove the spaces)



The form includes:

- A few short screening questions

- Your resume

- A 1-minute video introducing yourself



To show us you read all the way through, please rename your introduction video title to your name and your favorite dog breed.



Applications sent outside the form won't be reviewed. The form will be open until Friday, October 16.

title: Virtual Scheduling Coordinator for a High-Performing Dental Office
description:
Are you organized, personable, and passionate about helping patients receive exceptional dental care? Do you enjoy creating order, solving scheduling puzzles, and ensuring patients have a seamless experience from their first contact with the practice? If so, we're hiring a Virtual Scheduling Coordinator to join our remote team!

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on communication, organization, and helping a dental practice run efficiently behind the scenes.

About the Position

As our Virtual Scheduling Coordinator, you will serve as an extension of our front office team, ensuring patients are scheduled appropriately, insurance information is verified accurately, and patient inquiries receive prompt attention.

You will work remotely while supporting the daily operations of our growing dental practice through scheduling, patient communication, and administrative support.



Primary Responsibilities

Appointment Scheduling & Management

Schedule new and existing patient appointments according to office protocols.

Utilize alternative scheduling options to maximize provider productivity.

Help fill schedule openings and maintain a productive schedule.

Contact unscheduled treatment patients and overdue recare patients.

Assist patients with finding appointment times that meet their needs while supporting practice production goals.

Monitor upcoming schedules and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

Insurance Verification

Verify dental insurance benefits for all patients scheduled within the next 72 hours.

Confirm eligibility and effective dates.

Verify annual maximums and deductibles.

Confirm coverage percentages for common procedures, including exams, cleanings, X-rays, periodontal therapy, crowns, and restorative treatment.

Review frequency limitations, waiting periods, age limitations, downgrade policies, and missing tooth clauses.

Document all findings accurately in Open Dental.

Alert the team of any benefit concerns or discrepancies.

Data Entry & Record Management

Maintain accurate patient records in Open Dental.

Document appointment confirmations, insurance information, patient communications, and scheduling notes.

Ensure records remain organized, updated, and easily accessible.

Flag incomplete information and coordinate follow-up when needed.

Online Patient Communication

Monitor website inquiries, online scheduling requests, text messages, and social media inquiries.

Respond promptly with professional, friendly communication.

Convert inquiries into scheduled appointments whenever possible.

Route patient concerns to the appropriate team member when necessary.

Follow up with potential new patients who have not yet scheduled.

Appointment Confirmation & Follow-Up

Confirm upcoming appointments through phone, text, and
 communication.

Reduce last-minute cancellations and no-shows through proactive communication.

Maintain high confirmation rates and schedule retention.

Assist patients with financial questions and direct them to appropriate team members when needed.



Required Qualifications

Prior dental front office, scheduling, treatment coordinator, or administrative experience preferred.

Strong understanding of dental terminology.

Knowledge of dental insurance verification processes.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.

Experience with Open Dental, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, or similar dental software is preferred.

Reliable internet connection and quiet professional workspace.

HIPAA compliant with a commitment to patient confidentiality.

Self-motivated and capable of working independently.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:

Accurate insurance verifications completed daily.

High appointment confirmation rates.

Reduced cancellations and no-shows.

Increased scheduling conversion rates from online inquiries.

Clean and updated patient records.

Timely response to patient communications.

Effective schedule management that supports practice production goals.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

Work From Anywhere

Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while supporting an amazing team.

Flexible Schedule

We value results, accountability, and communication more than micromanagement.

Growth Opportunities

Exceptional team members are rewarded with raises, bonuses, and advancement opportunities.

Positive Team Culture

We're committed to creating an environment built on growth, communication, excellence, and mutual respect.



About Our Practice

We are a thriving dental practice dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care and creating outstanding patient experiences. We believe that systems, communication, and teamwork are the foundation of a successful practice.

We're looking for someone who takes pride in helping patients, enjoys staying organized, and wants to grow with a team that values excellence.



To Apply

Subject Line: "I Want to Work for You [Insert the Name of My Dog] 🐶"

Step 1:

Write 2–3 sentences explaining:

Why you're interested in this position.

Why you believe you'd be a great fit for our team.

Step 2:

Include the following:

Your resume.

A screenshot of a schedule you have managed (with patient information removed or blurred).

A 2-minute Loom video explaining how you would handle:

A patient who wants an appointment after work hours when the schedule is already full.

A patient who declines scheduling their next hygiene appointment due to financial concerns.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who is dependable, organized, proactive, and excited to grow with us. If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you!

But more than just a coordinator, we are looking for a PARTNER. I need someone trustworthy, competent, and reliable. We want someone to grow with our team — as we become more successful, you will too.



WATCH this review of one of our ROCKSTAR team members —

title: Home Care Recruiter & Scheduler — US Home Care Experience REQUIRED
description:
Full-Time | US Eastern Hours | $5–6/hr



Carolina Home Health Care Inc., a North Carolina home care agency, is hiring an experienced Recruiter & Scheduler to build our caregiver pipeline and support daily caregiver scheduling.



This is not a general VA position. Prior experience with a US home care agency or healthcare provider is required.



Primary Role — Caregiver Recruiting & Sourcing



You will actively build and manage our caregiver recruiting pipeline.



• Proactively source caregivers through job boards, resume databases,
/community groups, referrals, and past applicants

• Post and refresh job ads and manage incoming applicants

• Conduct phone pre-screening for experience, certifications, location/shift fit, pay expectations, availability, communication skills, and reliability

• Schedule interviews and follow up with candidates and no-shows

• Maintain an accurate candidate pipeline/tracker with daily status updates

• Support onboarding by collecting required documents and tracking background checks and health requirements

• Maintain a pipeline of qualified caregivers ready for placement

• Provide a weekly recruiting report: candidates sourced, screens completed, interviews scheduled, and hires/onboardings



Secondary Role — Scheduling & Operations

• Build and maintain daily and weekly caregiver schedules

• Fill open shifts and last-minute call-outs quickly

• Confirm coverage and communicate with caregivers and clients by phone, text, and

• Track attendance, schedule changes, and EVV exceptions

• Maintain accurate records in HHAExchange, Sandata, and/or CareBridge

• Match available caregivers with clients based on location, availability, and case requirements



REQUIRED Qualifications

• 1+ year of US home care or healthcare recruiting/scheduling experience

• Hands-on experience sourcing candidates, not just processing inbound applications

• Experience screening/pre-qualifying applicants by phone

• Experience with HHAExchange, Sandata, CareBridge, or another US home care scheduling/EVV system is a plus

• Excellent spoken and written English; this is a phone-heavy role

• Strong organization, follow-up, and attention to detail

• Reliable internet/backup connection, quiet workspace, and headset

• Willing to complete HIPAA training and sign a confidentiality agreement



Schedule & Pay

Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time

Approximately 9:00 PM–5:00 AM Manila time; you must be able to maintain US Eastern hours when daylight-saving time changes.

Pay: $5–6/hour, depending on experience, paid via Wise.



How to Apply

Your application subject must begin with: SCHEDULE



Answer all 3 questions:

1. Describe your US home care/healthcare recruiting experience. Where did you source caregivers, how did you pre-screen them, approximately how many caregivers did you manage, and which scheduling/EVV systems did you use?

2. Confirm that you can work 9:00 PM–5:00 AM Manila time, Monday–Friday, long term.

3. Include a 30–60 second voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) introducing yourself and briefly describing your recruiting/scheduling experience.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: US Tax Preparer (1040/1065/1120-S/1120) - Drake - CPA-Led US Firm - Part-Time, Full-Time in Tax Season
description:
ABOUT US

Prime & Ledger CPAs is a US CPA firm (Arkansas) serving small businesses nationwide - especially restaurants, salons and their owners. The firm is led by a CPA with Big Four and large-corporate tax experience. We prepare individual, partnership, S corporation and C corporation returns, plus FICA tip credit (IRC Section 45B) amended returns.



We work differently from most firms: we built our own tax preparation software ("P&L") that imports last year's return, bulk-imports client data, computes the return, and reconciles it against Drake Tax before filing. You will be trained on it. We want someone who wants to work accurately and efficiently with good tools - not someone who wants to key every number by hand.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Part-time (about 4 hours/day) year-round, moving to full-time (8 hours/day) January 15 - April 30 and August 15 - October 15.

- $7 - $10 per hour depending on experience and test results (about $600 - $900/month part-time; $1,200 - $1,800/month full-time in season). Raises for accuracy and turnaround.

- Flexible hours, but you must overlap at least 4 hours daily with US Central Time (e.g., 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM CT = 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Philippine time).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Import prior-year returns into our software and verify every extracted line and carryforward (capital loss, passive loss, QBI, Section 179, NOL).

- Organize client documents and bulk-import W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, 1098s, trial balances and payroll data.

- Prepare Forms 1040 (Schedules A, B, C, D/8949, E, SE), 1065, 1120-S and 1120, including K-1s, depreciation (Form 4562) and state returns.

- Reconcile each return in our software to Drake Tax line by line, explain every difference, and clear Drake diagnostics and e-file messages.

- Compare each return to the prior year and explain significant changes.

- Write clear review notes for the CPA reviewer and resolve review comments promptly.

- Draft open-items lists for clients (no direct client contact unless asked).

- Off-season: bookkeeping clean-up, payroll reports for FICA tip credit analysis, and extensions.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 full US tax seasons PREPARING returns (not only data entry) for a US CPA or EA firm.

- Hands-on experience with Form 1040 AND at least one of Form 1065 or 1120-S.

- Professional tax software experience. Drake strongly preferred; UltraTax, Lacerte, ProSeries, ProConnect or CCH accepted.

- Solid understanding of K-1s, basis, depreciation, and Schedule C/E reporting.

- Excellent written English; comfortable following checklists and written procedures.

- Reliable internet with backup power (UPS or generator) and a quiet, private workspace.

- A US PTIN, or willingness to obtain one when hired.

- Willing to sign an NDA, confidentiality and data-protection agreements, and provide an NBI clearance.



NICE TO HAVE

- Philippine CPA, or US EA / CPA candidate.

- Restaurant, salon or hospitality clients; payroll registers; Form 8846 (FICA tip credit).

- Multi-state returns, BBA partnership rules, Form 7203.

- QuickBooks Online or Xero.



SECURITY (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

You will work only inside our secure remote environment. No client data on personal devices, no downloads, no screenshots, no copying files outside our systems. Access is monitored. These rules protect our clients under US federal law (IRC Section 7216).



HOW WE HIRE

1. Apply using the instructions below.

2. Short video call (20 minutes).

3. PAID test: prepare a sample return with planted issues in our software and Drake, then write review notes.

4. 30-day paid trial, then a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly or your application will not be reviewed)

Start your application with "P&L Tax Season Ready" and answer:

1. How many US tax seasons have you worked, for what type of firm, and which return types did you prepare yourself?

2. Which tax software have you used, and for how many seasons? If Drake, which years?

3. Describe one difficult return you prepared and how you resolved the issue.

4. Do you have a PTIN? Will you get one if hired?

5. Your expected hourly rate, and whether you can work full-time January 15 - April 30.

This position will initially focus on YouTube, but there is significant opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and grow with our company.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, mistakes, stutters, and repeated sentences.

- Maintain natural, engaging pacing and conversational flow.

- Create clean, professional videos that keep viewers engaged.

- Follow our established editing style and brand guidelines.

- Submit completed videos for review and make revisions as needed.

- Develop thumbnails that communicate the video's main message and encourage clicks.

### 3. YouTube Uploading & Publishing

- Upload videos to YouTube Studio.

- Add provided titles, thumbnails, and descriptions.

- Prepare videos for review and approval before publishing.

- Ensure everything is accurate, organized, and properly formatted.



### 4. Opportunity for Growth



As our content production expands, this position may grow to include:



- Editing and publishing YouTube Shorts.

- Repurposing long-form videos into short-form social media content.

- Scheduling and distributing content across additional social media platforms.

- Helping manage content calendars and publishing schedules.

- Taking on broader content management and social media responsibilities.



We are looking for someone who is excited about growing into a larger role as the company expands.



## Required Skills



- Strong video editing experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar software.

- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

- Ability to create professional, engaging YouTube thumbnails.

- Good understanding of video pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI-powered tools.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Good written and spoken English comprehension.

- Ability to follow established brand guidelines and instructions.

- Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times.

- Comfortable working independently after training.



**Preferred but Not Required:**



- Experience with YouTube Studio.

- Experience using 
 for video reviews.

- Experience editing YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok videos.

- Familiarity with Google Drive and social media scheduling tools.



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, pays attention to details, and consistently delivers high-quality results.



You should have a good creative eye, understand what makes YouTube videos engaging, and be able to follow our brand guidelines without requiring constant supervision.



Initially, all videos, thumbnails, and descriptions will be submitted for approval. Once you've demonstrated consistency and an understanding of our standards, the goal is for you to manage the editing and publishing process independently.



We value reliability, initiative, communication, and long-term working relationships.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM EST (8 PM to 4 AM MNL)

4 PM to 12 AM EST (4 AM to 12 PM MNL)



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: SEO Organic + Local
description:
# Senior SEO Specialist – Local SEO & Organic SEO (100+ Business Locations)



**Job Type:** Full-Time / Long-Term  

**Location:** Remote  

**Experience:** 3+ years of proven SEO experience



## About the Role



We are seeking a highly experienced, results-driven **SEO Specialist** to manage and grow the online presence of a portfolio of 100+ local service businesses across multiple cities.



Our primary focus is ranking Google Business Profiles in Google Maps and ranking our websites organically for high-intent local service keywords.



Most of our websites are built using Hostinger, and many of our Google Business Profiles are relatively new.



We are looking for someone who can independently develop, execute, and manage a comprehensive SEO strategy—not someone who simply follows a checklist.



This is a long-term opportunity with significant growth potential as our portfolio expands.



## Key Responsibilities



**Google Business Profile & Local SEO**

- Optimize and manage 100+ Google Business Profiles.

- Improve Google Maps rankings and local search visibility.

- Conduct competitor research and geo-grid ranking analysis.

- Optimize GBP categories, services, descriptions, and other relevant information.

- Develop legitimate local citation and business directory strategies.

- Identify opportunities to improve local relevance and prominence.

- Monitor GBP performance, diagnose ranking issues, and address policy compliance.

- Implement strategies to improve visibility across competitive service areas.



**Organic SEO & Website Optimization**

- Develop and execute SEO strategies for 100+ websites.

- Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits.

- Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

- Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

- Create keyword maps and content strategies for individual websites.

- Optimize service pages and location-specific content.

- Implement relevant structured data/schema markup.

- Improve website speed, mobile usability, crawlability, and indexing.

- Identify and resolve duplicate-content and keyword cannibalization issues.

- Build high-quality, relevant backlinks through legitimate outreach and partnerships.

- Work with websites built using Hostinger and WordPress.



**SEO Management & Scaling**

- Build scalable SEO workflows and standard operating procedures.

- Prioritize SEO tasks based on ranking opportunities, competition, and business potential.

- Utilize automation tools to improve efficiency.

- Manage keyword rankings, backlinks, indexing, and local visibility across the portfolio.

- Maintain organized tracking for all businesses and websites.

- Develop repeatable SEO strategies while maintaining unique and useful content for each business.



**Reporting & Performance**

- Monitor organic rankings and Google Maps rankings.

- Track performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and local rank-tracking tools.

- Deliver weekly progress updates and monthly performance reports.

- Track organic traffic, phone calls, form submissions, and other leads.

- Identify underperforming locations and develop corrective action plans.

- Provide transparent reporting on work completed and measurable improvements.



## Required Qualifications



- Minimum 3 years of hands-on SEO experience.

- Proven experience ranking local service businesses in Google Maps and organic search.

- Strong understanding of Google's local ranking factors.

- Advanced knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.

- Experience with Google Business Profile optimization.

- Experience managing multiple websites or multi-location SEO campaigns.

- Proficiency with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and keyword research tools.

- Experience using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, BrightLocal, Local Falcon, or similar platforms.

- Understanding of local citations, link building, structured data, and technical website optimization.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage large workloads.

- Strong written English and communication skills.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in home services SEO (chimney sweep, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, cleaning, etc.).

- Experience managing 50+ websites or Google Business Profiles.

- Experience with Hostinger Website Builder and WordPress.

- Experience creating SEO automation workflows.

- Experience managing SEO campaigns across multiple cities.

- Ability to supervise content writers, link-building specialists, or virtual assistants as the portfolio grows.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, we expect the selected candidate to:



- Complete an initial audit of all assigned websites and GBPs.

- Identify the highest-priority ranking opportunities.

- Build and begin executing a structured SEO roadmap.

- Resolve critical technical and indexing issues.

- Establish accurate keyword and geo-grid ranking tracking.

- Implement repeatable workflows for scaling optimization.

- Demonstrate measurable progress on agreed performance indicators.



We understand that SEO takes time. We are looking for consistent execution, sound strategy, and sustainable ranking improvements rather than unrealistic guarantees.

 and Instagram advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

* Compensation: $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience.

* Long-term opportunity with potential for growth.

 newsletters or automated campaigns

PILLOW

Find the right creators → generate useful content → drive sales → retain the winners → scale what works.

title: Full-Time Senior Bookkeeper | AU
description:
PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



1. You do not have at least 5 years of hands-on Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience. General accounting experience outside Australia does not count towards this requirement.



2. You have never independently managed Australian payroll, including employee setup, weekly payroll processing, PAYG withholding and superannuation.



3. You are not confident with Australian GST, BAS and other relevant taxation requirements.



4. You do not have strong, hands-on experience using Xero, including bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable.



5. You have no practical experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.



6. You require constant supervision, regular reminders or step-by-step instructions to manage your daily responsibilities.



7. You are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where accuracy, urgency and accountability are essential.



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll.

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation.

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

TO APPLY

title: ServiceTitan Administrator & Operations Support Specialist
description:
About our company

JB’s is a veteran-owned construction and home-services business based in Northwest Florida. We serve our neighbors through electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, remodeling, construction, and related services.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceTitan Administrator who can become our internal ServiceTitan Champion.

Our goal is straightforward: our team needs a knowledgeable person who can answer questions, solve problems, complete administrative work, maintain the system, and help us use ServiceTitan effectively—without every issue going back to the owner.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a consulting-only position. We need someone who can both explain what needs to happen and complete the work.

Your primary responsibility

Take ownership of day-to-day ServiceTitan administration and internal support.

When a team member has a question or something is not working properly, you will investigate, resolve what is within your authority, coordinate with ServiceTitan support when necessary, and follow the issue through to a verified resolution.

You are not expected to know every answer immediately. You are expected to know how to investigate, find reliable answers, communicate clearly, and follow through.

What you will own

Team support and troubleshooting

Be the first point of contact for ServiceTitan questions from our office, technicians, sales staff, and managers. Help team members understand the correct workflow and investigate problems involving customer records, jobs, estimates, invoices, memberships, mobile usage, and system settings.

Distinguish between a training issue, a configuration issue, missing information, and a problem that requires ServiceTitan support.

Daily administration and system maintenance

Complete approved updates to records, templates, forms, job types, business units, and other settings within your assigned scope. Maintain a visible request list so important work does not get forgotten.

Identify incomplete or inconsistent records, investigate the cause, and coordinate corrections with the responsible department. Do not guess at missing financial information or change records simply to make a report look correct.

Pricebook maintenance

Maintain our approved pricebook structure, descriptions, categories, images, and related information. Implement approved service, material, equipment, and pricing updates.

Work with management and accounting to identify missing information or setup problems. Pricing strategy, margin targets, and accounting-policy decisions remain with authorized leadership.

For bulk changes, document the starting point, validate the proposed changes, obtain required approval, and verify the results after implementation.

Reporting and data quality

Prepare and maintain useful reports for management, including approved views of department performance, sales, completed work, unsold estimates, memberships, and job-cost information where available.

Understand what a report measures, which dates and filters it uses, and what information may be incomplete. Investigate discrepancies instead of simply forwarding a spreadsheet to the owner.

Maintain recurring report delivery and help managers understand how to use their reports.

Training and documentation

Create short, practical instructions and screen-recorded walkthroughs for recurring tasks. Train new employees on the workflows relevant to their roles and help existing employees correct repeated mistakes.

Maintain a JB’s ServiceTitan knowledge library so the same questions do not need to be answered from scratch repeatedly.

Help translate our approved operating procedures and Nexstar-based service processes into practical system workflows.

ServiceTitan support and vendor follow-through

Own support cases from initial investigation through resolution. Provide clear examples, relevant screenshots, affected record identifiers, and steps already attempted.

Attend appropriate support or account meetings, document action items, and complete approved follow-up work. Escalate decisions requiring management approval with a clear explanation and recommended next step.

Connected tools and ongoing improvements

Help investigate problems involving our approved ServiceTitan-connected tools, including website booking and other integrations we use.

Coordinate with vendors or technical specialists where needed. Advanced programming is not a core requirement, but you should be able to explain a problem clearly and test whether a fix works.

Recommend practical improvements while working within our existing subscriptions and approved budget.

Required experience

You must have at least two years of meaningful, hands-on ServiceTitan experience, including administration, configuration, troubleshooting, reporting, or implementation work.

Experience limited to call answering, appointment booking, or dispatching is not sufficient by itself.

You should be able to demonstrate:

- ServiceTitan administrative work you personally completed, including pricebook maintenance and reporting.

- Successful troubleshooting and the ability to explain a workflow to a nontechnical team member.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and careful handling of imports or bulk changes.

- Clear written and spoken English, dependable live availability, and independent follow-through.

Experience supporting U.S. HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home-service businesses is strongly preferred.

Preferred qualifications

ServiceTitan Certified Administrator certification is preferred. Please identify your credential and current status.

Experience with multi-trade businesses, memberships, job costing, QuickBooks integration support, purchasing or inventory workflows, and Nexstar-based operations is helpful.

Please be honest about which areas you know well and which would require additional training.

Authority and working relationships

You will report to the owner and work closely with our call-center manager, service manager, sales professional, and accounting support.

You will own system support and execution, not override department leaders.

Dispatch priorities, customer commitments, pricing policy, financial approvals, and employee-management decisions remain with the appropriate manager or owner.

You must obtain approval before making high-impact changes, enabling paid services, changing financial mappings, expanding access, or making changes that affect multiple departments.

What success looks like

Our team knows where to go for ServiceTitan help. Routine issues get handled without the owner becoming involved. Approved changes are completed accurately. Reports are dependable and clearly explained. Recurring problems lead to better training or a corrected process.

Most importantly, you make ServiceTitan easier for our team to use while reducing the owner’s daily administrative workload.

How to apply

Apply with the subject:

JB’s ServiceTitan Champion — Your Name

Include your résumé, expected monthly compensation, availability, and answers to these questions:

1. How long have you worked in ServiceTitan, and what administrative responsibilities did you personally own?

2. Describe a difficult ServiceTitan problem you investigated and resolved. What did you check, change, and verify?

3. What pricebook and reporting work have you completed yourself?

4. Have you trained other employees or managed ServiceTitan support cases? Give an example.

5. Which ServiceTitan areas are your strongest, and which would require additional training?

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment and live walkthrough using provided sample information or an appropriately controlled environment.

Do not submit confidential information, customer records, or unauthorized screenshots from another employer.

description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage

This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We run paid acquisition (Meta) for home-service and local-service businesses.



The role

You own the idea and the words behind our ads. Not the editing, not the media buying — the angle, the hook, the copy, and the read on what worked. You will write, not just brief.



What you'll do

Research each client's ICP (offer, objections, buying triggers, competitor ads) and turn it into 3–5 testable angles per cycle.

Write the full package per concept: hook, primary text, headline, lead-form questions, and calendar/landing page copy.

Write pre-qualifying copy — filtering out tire-kickers is the job, not maximizing raw lead volume.

Brief the video/design team with scripts and reference so they can execute without guesswork.

Read performance weekly (CPL, lead→booked, booked→show) and d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill — with a reason.

Keep our hook/body component library updated so winning ideas get reused, not rediscovered.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years writing direct-response copy for paid social (agency or in-house), with ads you can show us.

Native-level written English and a feel for how North American homeowners/small-business owners actually talk.

Comfort in Meta Ads Manager reporting — you can read a table and form an opinion.

Local-service, home-improvement, or lead-gen experience (strong plus).

Self-direction: we give you the account and the data, not a daily task list.





Not a fit if: you're primarily a designer/editor, you've only written brand or SEO content, or you need a creative director to hand you angles.



At the top of your response to this job post put "Copywriting Creatives & Creative Strategy" so that we know you've read the post.

title: Bookkeeper - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re in our clients’ files every day, so their books are always current and they can make decisions on real numbers. Bookkeeping is the backbone of everything we do.



We’re looking for a Bookkeeper to look after the day-to-day books for a portfolio of hospitality clients. You’ll keep files reconciled and up to date, run payroll, prepare BAS/IAS for review, and be a friendly, reliable point of contact for clients’ questions. You’ll work alongside our accountants and report to the Director.

▪ Reconcile bank, credit card and clearing accounts in Xero daily, keeping client files current

▪ Process supplier bills, receipts and sales data, including POS and delivery platform reconciliations

▪ Run weekly and fortnightly payroll, including STP, super and leave, with award-based wages

▪ Prepare BAS/IAS and payroll reconciliations for accountant review

▪ Keep client queries organised and send them out on a regular weekly cycle

▪ Help clean up and catch up files for new clients

▪ Flag anything unusual in the numbers to the accounting team early



What you’ll bring

▪ 5 years’ bookkeeping experience, ideally in an accounting practice

▪ Strong Xero skills, including bank feeds, reconciliations and payroll

▪ Working knowledge of GST, BAS and payroll compliance (STP, super, PAYG withholding)

▪ Great attention to detail and the ability to manage several client files at once

▪ Clear, friendly communication with business owners

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation (e.g. Hospitality Industry General Award), POS and rostering integrations, e.g. Square, Lightspeed, Deputy.

You own the idea and the words behind our ads. Not the editing, not the media buying — the angle, the hook, the copy, and the read on what worked. You will write, not just brief.



What you'll do

Research each client's ICP (offer, objections, buying triggers, competitor ads) and turn it into 3–5 testable angles per cycle.

Write the full package per concept: hook, primary text, headline, lead-form questions, and calendar/landing page copy.

Write pre-qualifying copy — filtering out tire-kickers is the job, not maximizing raw lead volume.

Brief the video/design team with scripts and reference so they can execute without guesswork.

Read performance weekly (CPL, lead→booked, booked→show) and d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill — with a reason.

Keep our hook/body component library updated so winning ideas get reused, not rediscovered.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years writing direct-response copy for paid social (agency or in-house), with ads you can show us.

Native-level written English and a feel for how North American homeowners/small-business owners actually talk.

Comfort in Meta Ads Manager reporting — you can read a table and form an opinion.

Local-service, home-improvement, or lead-gen experience (strong plus).

Self-direction: we give you the account and the data, not a daily task list.





Not a fit if: you're primarily a designer/editor, you've only written brand or SEO content, or you need a creative director to hand you angles.



At the top of your response to this job post put "Copywriting Creatives & Creative Strategy" so that we know you've read the post.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Mandatory: Must be based in Manila, Cebu, Cavite or Davao







Salary: 90,000 PHP per month 







What You’ll Be Responsible For







Campaign Creation & Strategy







Build, launch, and optimize Meta ad campaigns (lead gen, conversion, retargeting, custom funnels).







Craft angles, hooks, and creatives aligned with real market psychology.







Develop testing roadmaps — headlines, creatives, audiences, bidding models.







Set up proper structure from Day 1: naming, rules, tracking, exclusions.

Diagnose performance drops with speed: attribution, creative fatigue, audience saturation, tracking issues, learning phase resets.

Work with designers/editors to produce scroll-stopping creatives.







Initiate new concepts based on data, not opinions.

Keep campaigns compliant and avoid unnecessary account risks.







Communicate proactively — no surprises, ever.

4+ years hands-on Meta Ads experience managing real budgets







Performing landing page split tests with CRO techniques applied







Proven track record of hitting CPL/CPA targets and scaling campaigns profitably.

Strong analytical mindset — decisions driven by data, not guesses.

Comfortable working in fast-paced, performance-driven environments.







Familiar with CAPI solutions, tracking hygiene, and troubleshooting.







Bonus: Experience with GoHighLevel, AI Tool workflows, CRO & Landing Page Development
