title: Staffing/ Onboarding coordinator
description:
Position summary



We’re hiring a detail-oriented Recruiting and Onboarding Coordinator to support our hiring process from application review through the start of onboarding. This person will review resumes against role requirements, coordinate and conduct initial interviews, communicate with candidates, and help selected candidates begin onboarding.



The ideal candidate is organized, professional, comfortable speaking with candidates, and able to keep hiring steps moving while maintaining accurate records and protecting confidential information.



 Key responsibilities



- Review resumes and applications against job requirements and identify candidates for consideration.

- Track applicants, interview stages, and follow-up tasks in the company’s hiring records or system.

- Contact candidates to arrange interviews and confirm dates, times, time zones, and meeting details.

- Conduct initial screening interviews using agreed questions and evaluation criteria.

- Record clear, job-related interview notes and share candidate summaries with the hiring manager.

- Communicate professionally with candidates about next steps and timelines.

- Follow up on outstanding applications, interview feedback, and candidate questions.

- Help selected candidates begin onboarding by sharing instructions, collecting required information, and tracking completion.

- Escalate candidate concerns, hiring decisions, or documentation issues to the appropriate manager.

- Handle applicant and employee information confidentially and consistently.



Required qualifications



- Strong written and spoken English.

- Experience in recruiting coordination, resume screening, interviewing, customer service, or administrative support.

- Clear, professional communication and strong candidate-service skills.

- Good organization and follow-through across multiple candidates and open roles.

- Ability to conduct structured, job-related interviews and document responses accurately.

- Comfort using
, calendars, spreadsheets, video meeting tools, and online forms.

- Reliable internet, a suitable private workspace, and availability during agreed working hours.

- Discretion when handling personal and confidential information.



 Preferred qualifications



- Experience supporting hiring for a business in another country.

- Familiarity with applicant tracking systems or recruitment platforms.

- Experience coordinating across time zones.

- Experience supporting new-hire onboarding and maintaining personnel records.



 Success measures



In the first 30 days, the coordinator should be able to:



- Screen applications consistently against the requirements provided.

- Schedule interviews accurately and reduce avoidable delays or missed meetings.

- Conduct professional initial interviews and provide useful, objective notes.

- Keep candidate records and follow-up actions current.

- Help selected candidates complete initial onboarding steps promptly.



Hiring process



Candidates may be asked to complete a short work sample: review a fictional resume against a role description, draft an interview invitation or candidate response, and explain how they would begin onboarding a selected candidate. The exercise should use fictional information only.

title: SEO & GEO Strategy Lead-AI Search & Technical SEO
description:
About the Role



We are seeking an experienced SEO & GEO Strategy Lead to own and lead our organic search and AI-search strategy.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who understands both traditional SEO and the rapidly evolving world of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search, and answer-engine visibility. The ideal candidate combines deep technical SEO expertise with strong content strategy, authority building, analytics, AI knowledge, leadership, and exceptional organizational skills. This person must be an extremely organized, proactive self-starter who can manage multiple SEO initiatives simultaneously, establish clear priorities, maintain detailed project tracking, lead a small team, and ensure projects move from strategy through execution and measurement. You will be responsible for developing and executing the overall SEO and GEO strategy, identifying opportunities before being asked, and continuously adapting our approach as Google, AI search, and the broader search landscape evolve.



Key Responsibilities



SEO & Organic Growth Strategy



-Own the overall SEO and organic growth strategy

-Develop short-, medium-, and long-term SEO roadmaps tied to traffic, visibility, rankings, conversions, and revenue

-Identify high-impact opportunities proactively rather than waiting for assignments

-Monitor Google algorithm updates, AI-search developments, and changes in SEO best practices

-Analyze competitors and identify keyword, content, backlink, technical, and authority gaps

-Prioritize initiatives based on expected business impact rather than rankings alone

-Create clear strategies and execution plans for both traditional search and AI-driven discovery

-Work closely with marketing, content, development, merchandising, and e-commerce teams





Technical SEO

Own and continuously improve technical SEO across the website, including:



-Site architecture and crawlability

-Indexation

-XML sitemaps

-Robots.txt

-Canonicalization

-Redirects

-Duplicate-content management

-Internal linking architecture

--Core Web Vitals

-Page speed

-Mobile SEO

-JavaScript SEO

-Structured data and 
 markup

-Product, category, article, FAQ, organization, breadcrumb, and other applicable schema

-Faceted navigation and URL parameter management

-Technical SEO audits and implementation roadmaps



The candidate must be comfortable identifying technical issues, understanding their business impact, prioritizing fixes, and working directly with developers to ensure proper implementation.



GEO & AI Search Strategy

Develop and lead our Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search strategy.



Responsibilities include:

-Improve brand and content visibility within AI-powered search and answer engines

-Understand how traditional SEO signals interact with AI-generated answers and recommendations

-Structure content so it can be easily understood, referenced, and surfaced by search engines and AI systems

-Develop strategies around entities, topical authority, structured data, citations, brand mentions, and authoritative sources

-Evaluate how AI platforms are discovering, understanding, and referencing our brand and competitors

-Identify opportunities to improve visibility across conversational and AI-powered search experiences

-Monitor the evolution of GEO, answer-engine optimization, and AI search

-Test emerging strategies and measure which tactics create meaningful business results

-Separate meaningful developments from short-lived SEO or AI trends

-The candidate should understand that GEO is an evolving discipline and be comfortable testing, measuring, learning, and adapting quickly as the ecosystem changes.



AI & Automation

We want someone who actively and intelligently uses AI as part of their daily SEO workflow. The candidate should understand how to use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of:



Keyword and topic research

Content briefs

SERP analysis

Competitor research

Content-gap analysis

Internal-linking analysis

Schema development and validation

SEO audits

Content optimization

Data analysis

Reporting

Research

Workflow automation

Process efficiency



We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate articles.

The successful candidate will understand how to use AI strategically while maintaining quality, originality, accuracy, search intent, brand authority, and editorial standards.



On-Page SEO & Content Strategy



-Develop keyword strategies based on search intent, competition, opportunity, and business value

-Optimize product pages, category pages, landing pages, and informational content

-Build scalable internal-linking strategies

-Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, copy, URLs, images, and structured content

-Conduct content-gap and competitor analyses

-Develop topic clusters and topical-authority strategies

-Create and manage an SEO-focused blog and content roadmap

-Provide detailed SEO briefs to writers and content teams

-Audit existing content and determine what should be improved, consolidated, redirected, expanded, or removed

-Ensure content supports both traditional SEO and emerging GEO objectives



Off-Page SEO & Authority Building



-Develop and manage a sustainable authority-building strategy that includes:

-Backlink acquisition

-Digital PR

-Guest posting

-Relevant industry placements

-Brand mentions

-Partnerships

-Link-gap analysis

-Competitor backlink analysis

-Outreach strategies

-Identification of high-quality authoritative websites



The candidate must understand the difference between high-quality authority building and low-quality or spam-based link building and protect the company from tactics that could create long-term SEO risk.



Analytics & Performance

Must have strong working knowledge of:



Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Search Console

Ahrefs

Semrush

The candidate must be able to use data to identify opportunities, diagnose problems, measure performance, and make strategic decisions.



Key metrics may include:



Organic revenue

Organic traffic

Non-branded search growth

Rankings and search visibility

Impressions

Click-through rate

Conversions

Indexed pages

Crawl health

Backlink quality and authority

Content performance

AI Search / GEO visibility

Brand mentions and citations within AI-generated results



This role is expected to go beyond reporting numbers.



The Strategy Lead should be able to explain:

What happened?

Why did it happen?

What does the data tell us?

What should we do next?



Organization, Project Management & Execution



Exceptional organization is a critical requirement for this position.

The successful candidate must be able to:

Manage numerous SEO, content, technical, GEO, and backlink initiatives simultaneously

Maintain a clearly prioritized SEO roadmap and project calendar

Break strategies into specific tasks, owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes

Maintain detailed documentation of projects, tests, findings, decisions, and results

Create repeatable processes and SOPs for the SEO team

Track projects from initial concept through implementation and measurement

Follow up proactively with developers, writers, designers, agencies, and other stakeholders

Keep the team organized and accountable to deadlines

Run highly organized weekly SEO meetings with clear priorities and action items

Distinguish between urgent issues, high-impact opportunities, and lower-priority work

Communicate project status, roadblocks, results, and next steps clearly to management

Ensure recommendations are actually implemented rather than remaining in reports or audits

We are looking for someone who creates structure rather than someone who needs structure created for them.





Leadership & Team Management

This position will lead a small SEO/content team and coordinate with other departments and external partners.

Responsibilities include:

Set strategic priorities and quarterly objectives

Translate strategy into clear execution plans

Assign and review work

Create accountability across projects and team members

Coach and develop team members

Manage freelancers, agencies, or external SEO resources when needed

Review quality of technical SEO, content, backlink, and GEO work

Ensure projects move from recommendation to implementation

Communicate SEO priorities clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Hold team members and partners accountable for deadlines and results





Required Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on SEO experience

Strong technical SEO expertise

Strong understanding of on-page and off-page SEO

Demonstrated experience developing SEO strategy, not simply executing tasks

Exceptional organizational and project-management skills

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and team members simultaneously

Strong knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4

Advanced working knowledge of Ahrefs and Semrush

Experience with structured data and schema markup

Experience developing and managing blog and content strategies

Experience with backlink acquisition, guest posting, outreach, and authority building

Experience conducting technical SEO audits

Experience working with developers on SEO implementations

Strong understanding of AI-powered search, GEO, and the changing search landscape

Practical experience using AI tools within SEO workflows

Experience leading or managing a small team

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Strong strategic thinking and prioritization skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills





What We're Looking For

We want someone who is a highly organized, proactive self-starter, strong strategist, and effective leader.

You should naturally ask:

What opportunities are we missing?

Why are competitors outranking us?

What has changed in Google or AI search?

Where are the biggest technical SEO opportunities?

What should we test next?

What will have the greatest impact on organic revenue?

Who owns the next action, when is it due, and how will we measure whether it worked?

You should not need management to continually identify opportunities, establish your priorities, organize your workload, or follow up on unfinished projects.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership.

The right person will continuously study changes in Google Search, AI search, GEO, SEO technology, consumer search behavior, and industry best practices, translate those developments into actionable strategies, and ensure those strategies are executed successfully.





Success in This Role

Success means building a well-organized, measurable, and scalable organic-growth engine that improves visibility across both traditional search and the emerging AI-search ecosystem.

We are looking for someone who can combine strategy, technical SEO, content, authority building, analytics, AI, leadership, organization, and disciplined execution to produce measurable business growth.

title: CEO for Small Business (Remote, US Business Hours)
description:
Finch Harbor is a managed services business. We hire Filipino professionals who work with our American small business clients. Finch Harbor employs you and pays you.



This role is with a window-cleaning company in Nashville, Tennessee, in business since 2013. The owner is our owner's sister. She has run it for 13 years, and she wants someone better than she is. We are looking for someone to revolutionize how it runs. This position takes ownership of the growth and management of the company.



What you'll do



Just like the owner does today, you'll start with the hands-on work:

• Run the company's reports by hand.

• Find missed punches on crew timesheets and get them corrected.

• Fill out employee write-ups.

• Call customers.



As you learn the business:

• Build a deep understanding of the company's market and every business process.

• Bring analytical management to the company: measure what is working and what is not, and act on it.



Over time:

• Take over the growth and management of the company.

• Ensure the business is on track to improve performance and resume meeting its growth goals.

• Lead the company's people.



How the role works



You will assist with and oversee all administrative and management functions for the company's Filipino office staff. You will direct the line managers on improvements, discipline and incentives, based on data, and rely on their expertise for supervision on the ground. The field managers who run the crews are experts in safety and skilled work. You will enforce company policy while building a collaborative relationship with them.



This is not a temporary job. The first months are detailed, hands-on work, and it grows into running the company. The business has been stable for 13 years and is the leading window-cleaning company in its region. The company has hired strong former leaders before, and they have typically grown it by 20% a year or more. Our vision is a $15 million company. If you make a big dent toward that vision, there are significant opportunities for growth, and your income grows with it.



Requirements



We only review applications that meet every requirement.

• You have run a company or a whole department, in the Philippines or abroad, and overseen around 50 people. You have at least 5 years as a people leader.

• C2-level English, spoken and written. The interviews are conducted entirely in English.

• Full-time during US business hours, Central Time. That is overnight in the Philippines, so confirm you can sustain a night schedule.

• Your own laptop, stable internet and a quiet place to work.

• A background check before any offer. We verify your employment and education, including the positions you held and your dates in each role.



Preferred

• An MBA.

• A college degree.



What we offer

• A salary of $2,000 a month, for 40 to 50 hours a week.

• After each quarter in which you grow the company at an annual rate of at least 20%, the owner pays you a fixed incentive, discussed at interview.



Start date



We'd like you to start within two weeks. If you need to give notice to your current employer, we'll work around it.



To apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, tell us about a business or department you turned from declining to growing, with the numbers.

title: International Logistics Manager
description:
Now Hiring: International Logistics Manager



TETON is a fast-growing Outdoor Brand based in Salt Lake City, Utah. We are passionate about our goal - providing one billion and one outdoor experiences. How do we accomplish this? We make cool outdoor gear like sleeping bags, camp pads, backpacks, cots, and tents. Why? Because we think being outdoors and enjoying nature gives a little extra happiness in one's life.



Location: Remote – Philippines (Online Specialist)

Employment: Full-Time, 40 hours per week

Schedule: Flexible, with required overlap across U.S. and international time zones

Reports to: Director of Operations



Position Overview

Teton is seeking an experienced, proactive International Logistics Manager to oversee international freight operations, lead our logistics team, and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

This position manages shipments from our international factories to Teton's U.S. and Canadian warehouses, third-party logistics (3PL) facilities, and retail and wholesale clients receiving products directly from our factories.

We're looking for an independent problem-solver who takes ownership, negotiates effectively, builds strong relationships, and continuously looks for better ways to operate.



Key Responsibilities

International Freight & Direct Import Management

• Oversee international shipments from factory readiness through final delivery and receipt.

• Coordinate with factories, freight forwarders, ocean carriers, drayage providers, warehouses, and 3PL partners.

• Manage client Direct Import shipments, including bookings, routing, documentation, and client-specific requirements.

• Proactively resolve shipment delays, booking issues, equipment shortages, and other transportation challenges.

• Optimize container utilization, shipment consolidation, routing, and delivery schedules.

• Coordinate with outsourced customs clearance partners and ensure accurate, timely shipping documentation.

• Oversee cargo protection standards, transportation-related damage investigations, freight claims, and receiving discrepancies.

• Develop contingency plans to minimize shipping disruptions and maintain reliable delivery performance.

Freight Cost Optimization & Strategic Development

• Research, compare, and negotiate competitive freight rates and transportation agreements.

• Identify opportunities for direct drayage contracts, alternative shipping routes, and other cost-saving arrangements.

• Audit freight invoices, challenge unnecessary charges, and pursue appropriate credits or refunds.

• Monitor freight costs, budgets, and carrier performance, providing analysis and recommendations to leadership.

• Research and evaluate new 3PL partners and opportunities to expand or optimize Teton's fulfillment network.

• Develop cost-benefit analyses and recommendations for logistics improvements and strategic initiatives.

Logistics Systems & Process Improvement

• Maintain accurate shipment tracking, milestone visibility, and logistics reporting using systems such as Airtable and Fishbowl.

• Establish and improve procedures, documentation standards, and performance metrics.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology, AI, and automation.

• Monitor logistics KPIs, including freight costs, transit times, on-time delivery, and provider performance.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

• Directly manage and develop the Inbound Logistics Coordinator and other logistics support personnel.

• Establish clear priorities, accountability, and effective coverage across international time zones.

• Collaborate closely with the Supply Chain Manager to coordinate shipping schedules with production and replenishment needs.

• Ensure continued support for factory purchase order submissions under the Supply Chain Manager's direction.

• Serve as the primary contact for logistics issues, communicating proactively with internal teams and external partners.



Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in international logistics, ocean freight, freight forwarding, or transportation management.

• Strong knowledge of container shipping and international freight operations, particularly from Asia to North America.

• Proven experience negotiating freight rates, evaluating transportation options, and identifying cost savings.

• Excellent analytical skills, including Excel proficiency and transportation cost analysis.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently manage complex logistics challenges.

• Experience leading or supervising logistics personnel.

• Excellent English communication, organization, and relationship-management skills.

• Working knowledge of Incoterms, shipping documentation, and international trade processes.

• Ability to manage a flexible schedule and collaborate effectively across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with direct drayage arrangements, 3PL evaluation, or logistics network optimization.

• Experience managing Direct Import shipments for major retailers, including Amazon.

• Familiarity with Amazon Global, Vendor Central, Century VMS, or similar booking platforms.

• Experience with Airtable, Fishbowl, or transportation management systems.

• Experience with freight claims, cargo damage investigations, and freight cost auditing.

• Experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve logistics operations.



Work Schedule

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with a flexible schedule designed to support collaboration across U.S. and international time zones.

The selected candidate must be available for Teton's weekly Tuesday leadership meeting from 9:00–10:30 AM Mountain Time and maintain sufficient overlap with U.S.-based teams, freight providers, international partners, and direct reports.

The specific schedule will be established collaboratively to ensure effective communication and operational coverage.



What Success Looks Like

• International shipments run smoothly, with issues anticipated and resolved proactively.

• Freight costs are actively managed, with measurable savings and improved provider performance.

• Shipment tracking and communication are accurate, timely, and reliable.

• Logistics personnel are well-managed, accountable, and effective.

• Teton's logistics network becomes more efficient, cost-effective, and scalable.



How to Apply



• Use 8 or MORE Apply Points

• Attach your updated résumé

• Send a brief introduction explaining why you would be a good fit for this role.

• Include a current internet-speed test.

• Share the best times to contact you for an interview. (We are MDT, Mountain Daylight Time)

• Before applying, please visit 
 to learn more about our products and company.

title: GHL Automation & AI Workflow Specialist

We currently use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify relevant senior decision-makers, HR leaders, and executive recruiters. We'd like to streamline the research and list-building process using AI and automation to produce accurate, well-organized spreadsheets of targeted networking contacts.



The goal is to reduce repetitive manual work, improve accuracy, and create reliable processes that can scale as our business grows.



CURRENT & FUTURE STATE

We already have GoHighLevel set up, with CRM pipelines, client communications, and several automations in place.

We're not looking for someone to build a new GHL account from scratch. We need someone who can understand how our business operates, assess what's working and what needs improvement, and translate our processes into reliable automations.



Priorities:

- Improve the reliability and efficiency of existing workflows.

- Reduce manual administrative work for our small team.

- Strengthen prospect follow-up, client onboarding, and program management.

- Improve visibility into where prospects and clients are in their journey.

- Use AI and automation to make client networking research and contact-list creation faster and more accurate.



The Kind of Work We Need Help With



1. GoHighLevel CRM & Automation

- Building, improving, and troubleshooting GHL workflows.

- Managing CRM pipelines and automatically moving contacts between stages.

- Automated and scheduled prospect and client
s.

- Tags, custom fields, contact records, and segmentation.

- Forms, calendars, appointment scheduling, and reminders.

- Program enrollment, onboarding, milestones, renewals, and follow-up.

- Payment links, installment payment reminders, and payment-related workflows.

- Internal notifications and team task assignments.

- Testing automations, identifying errors, and preventing missed communications.

- Recommending opportunities to simplify and automate our current processes.



2. AI & LinkedIn Sales Navigator Lead Generation

We provide targeted networking campaigns for senior-level job seekers. An important first step is identifying the right people at the right companies.



We'd like help developing a more automated process to:

- Research target companies based on each client's industry, role, geography, and career goals.

- Identify senior decision-makers, hiring leaders, CHROs, HR executives, and relevant recruiters using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Organize contacts into accurate, structured Excel or Google Sheets files.

- Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, categorization, and quality checks.

- Reduce manual copying, data cleanup, and repetitive list preparation.

- Create a repeatable process that can be customized for individual clients.



We're looking for practical solutions that respect platform restrictions and data privacy requirements, rather than unreliable scraping methods.



3. Business Process Improvement

Beyond individual automations, we'd value someone who can look at how our systems work together and identify opportunities to simplify operations.

This might include connecting GHL with our scheduling,
, payment, client tracking, and reporting tools.



Tools We Use

Essential experience:

- GoHighLevel (GHL) — strong hands-on automation experience.

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator — familiarity with prospect research and targeted list building.

- ChatGPT and/or Claude — practical experience using AI to improve business workflows.



Additional experience is a plus:

- CRM & Automation: Zapier, Airtable, Guidance Gate

- AI & Meeting Tools: Fathom

- Sales & Networking: LinkedIn, Expandi

- Scheduling & Marketing: Calendly, Mailchimp

- Business Tools: Google Workspace, Gmail, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets

- Payments: Stripe



You don't need expertise in every tool. Strong GHL and AI-enablement skills, practical problem-solving, and the ability to connect systems are the priorities.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:



You should have real experience building and maintaining automations in GoHighLevel, rather than simply general familiarity with the platform. Ideally, you're someone who:

- Can quickly understand an existing GHL account and how its workflows connect.

- Understands business processes and can recommend simple, dependable solutions.

- Has experience with AI-assisted research, data organization, or lead-generation workflows.

- Can implement, test, document, and troubleshoot what you build.

- Communicates clearly and explains technical decisions in plain English.

- Is comfortable working independently with a small business owner and remote team.

- Is thoughtful about cost and avoids unnecessary tools or overly complicated solutions.



I don't necessarily know the technical terminology for everything I want to achieve. I need someone who can ask the right questions, understand the intended result, and turn that into a working solution.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following:

- How long have you worked with GoHighLevel?

- What types of GHL automations have you built?

- Describe a relatively complex automation you've implemented and the business problem it solved.

- Are you comfortable improving an existing GHL setup rather than starting from scratch?

- Have you built AI-assisted lead-generation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator research, or automated spreadsheet workflows? Please describe an example.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be supporting the two founders of a well-established Canadian staffing and consulting firm based in Toronto. They run a highly systemised, fast-moving business, and they're the kind of leaders people want to work for: patient teachers with high standards, who invest in training, tooling, and growth for their team. They automate anything that can be automated, document their processes, and give their people the systems and support to do great work. This is a company that has kept the same right-hand EA for years at a time because they know how to set the right person up to win.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to become the operational right hand to both founders. This is a blended role: you'll run two demanding executive calendars and inboxes and own a broad, varied administrative workload that keeps the business moving behind the scenes.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a narrow checklist and told exactly what to do all day. It's for a confident, self-managing operator who thrives on variety, builds their own systems, and stays calm when they're switching between very different tasks. The founders manage their own time down to the 15-minute block, use tools like ClickUp and Calendly, and will meet with you regularly, drip responsibilities to you as you master them, and give you SOPs to follow. The learning curve is real, and the people who succeed here lean into it rather than get overwhelmed by it.

This role starts as an executor and is built to grow. As you learn how each founder thinks, you'll take on more ownership and judgment over time.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (Toronto) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT (night shift)

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Quarterly Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support (Two Founders)

• Calendar orchestration — Manage two busy, highly structured executive calendars, protect focus time, and keep both founders' days running smoothly — coordinating across their schedules without dropping a beat.

• Inbox management — Triage and organise both inboxes, draft replies for review, and gradually take over sending on their behalf as you learn their voice and judgment.

• Meeting prep — Prepare briefing materials and agendas, and make sure both founders walk into every meeting ready.

• Proactive time management — Run their calendars proactively the way they run their own — booked, protected, colour-coded, and always a step ahead.



Administrative & Operations Support

• Documents & agreements — Prepare and execute client agreements, build and customise proposals, and produce clean, professional documents, reports, and presentations.

• Systems & filing — Own and organise a large Google Drive database so records are structured and easy to find.

• Process execution — Follow documented SOPs to the letter and build your own systems where none exist — you'll be trusted to create order, not wait for it.

• RFP & portal management — Manage the process around RFP solicitations and government portals (managing the workflow, not answering them), keeping deadlines and submissions on track.

• General admin — Own the wide range of recurring and one-off admin that comes across the founders' desks so they can stay focused on high-value work.

Sales & Business Development Support

• Lead follow-up & CRM — Support business development with lead follow-up, prospect tracking, and keeping the CRM clean and up to date.

• Scheduling — Book and coordinate business development and prospect meetings.



Qualifications

Required

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a founder, CEO, or senior executive — ideally supporting more than one executive at a time

• Proven ability to manage demanding executive calendars and inboxes with discretion, structure, and good judgment

• Strong written and verbal English — you'll draft emails, documents, and correspondence on behalf of the founders daily

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

• Experience with broad, varied admin — documents, proposals, filing, process management — not just calendar and inbox

• Highly organised and self-disciplined — you keep everything in one system, not scattered across sticky notes, notebooks, and half-used lists

• A confident, self-managing operator who can switch gears between very different tasks without getting overwhelmed

• Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems early, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

• Comfortable working efficiently and being measured on output — you get the right work done in a reasonable amount of time

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

• Able to reliably work night shift (Toronto business hours) long-term



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting two or more executives at once

• Experience with ClickUp or another project management tool (Asana, Monday, Trello)

• Familiarity with CRM tools (logging contacts, deals, and activity)

• Experience with proposals, RFPs, or agreement/contract administration

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to work within an AI-first, automation-first workflow

• Background in staffing, recruiting, professional services, or consulting



Who Thrives in This Role

The founders have kept an EA in this role for years at a time when they've found the right person. Here's who that is:

• You lean into a learning curve instead of being intimidated by it — when something's new, your attitude is “I'll figure it out.”

• You thrive on variety and can switch between very different tasks in a single day without losing your footing

• You build your own systems and processes — you create order rather than wait to be handed it

• You're calm and low-drama under a full plate — you don't overthink or talk yourself out of things before you try them

• You're disciplined and organised — you manage your own time as tightly as the people you support manage theirs

• You work efficiently and take ownership — when something's in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarise, you don't ramble

• You're a fast learner who picks up new tools, systems, and preferences quickly, and genuinely enjoy working smarter with AI and automation



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth

• Long-term, stable client placement with founders who invest in their people

• Clear KPIs, documented processes, and structured onboarding

• Regular coaching, training, and performance feedback

• Room to grow from executor into a broader ownership role over time

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply

Please email the following to 

• Updated resume

• Short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and your experience as an Executive Assistant

• Subject line: SFSS Executive Assistant – [Your Name]

Only candidates that follow the instructions above will be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

• Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

• Skills and communication assessment (30 min)

• Final client interview (30 min)

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (AI-First)
description:
About Atomic Finch



Atomic Finch builds websites for local small businesses (plumbers, salons, contractors and similar) and runs them on a monthly plan that includes hosting, local SEO, content and Google Business Profile work. Most of the delivery is automated: our platform uses AI to build each site, serves it on Cloudflare, and runs the monthly SEO and content work.



The Role

You'll be the senior developer on our platform team, working directly with the founder across the whole system: the internal dashboard, the site-building engine, the hosting layer and the automation that runs every month. Once you know the platform, you'll also support custom customer sites, and you'll grow into leading our developer team: reviewing code, helping interview, and setting standards.



What you'll work on, in order of priority:

- The platform (first 1 to 2 months). Learn the system end to end and ship features and fixes across it.

Customer sites. Own the site kit that custom designs are built on, and support designers and developers when a custom site needs platform work.

- The team. Review other developers' pull requests, help Maria interview technical candidates, and write the standards new developers follow.



Our stack

- TypeScript and Node throughout

- Next.js / React for our internal dashboard and marketing site

- Cloudflare: Workers, Workers for Platforms, D1 (SQLite), R2

- Astro for customer websites

- Linux VPS: pm2, Caddy, cron

- GitHub: pull requests, GitHub Actions CI, automated code review (Greptile)

- AI: the Anthropic API and Claude Code, both inside the product and in how we build it

- Stripe for billing, Linear for tasks, Slack for communication



Must have

- 4+ years shipping production software end to end, mainly in TypeScript / Node

- Next.js / React on the app side, and serverless or edge platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel or AWS Lambda) on the infrastructure side

- Solid SQL (SQLite, D1 or Postgres)

- Comfortable on Linux servers: SSH, process managers, reverse proxies, cron, reading logs to find a problem

- Daily, serious use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor agents, Codex or similar), and the ability to show how you direct and check their work with tests, review, and evidence before you trust it

- Strong Git and pull request habits; you treat CI and code review as the quality gate

- Good security instincts: handling secrets, authentication, keeping customers' data separate, giving access only where it's needed

- Clear written English. Your pull request descriptions and Slack updates make sense without a call.



Strong plus

- Has built AI features with the Anthropic or OpenAI APIs: tool use, agent loops, prompt and evaluation work

- Has written agent instructions, skills or tools (CLAUDE.md files, Cursor rules, MCP servers) for a team

- Experience with Astro or other static-site frameworks, Stripe, or GitHub Actions

- Has led or mentored other developers and reviewed their code

- Has worked at an agency or freelanced for small-business clients



How we work

- Contract, remote, paid hourly. You log your hours weekly and get paid weekly through Wise.

- You need at least 4 hours a day overlapping 9 AM to 6 PM Mountain Time (US).

- Async first. Tasks come through Linear, conversation happens in Slack, and every change goes through a pull request with CI and code review.

- You never contact customers. Customer conversations go through our account managers.

- Access grows with trust. You start with pull requests only. Server and production access come later.

- Honesty is not negotiable. We never invent customer reviews, statistics, awards or credentials, on any site or in any listing.



How to apply

- Your CV or LinkedIn

- Your GitHub, or links to 2 or 3 things you've built (and what you did on each)

- A short paragraph on how you use AI coding tools day to day: which tools, what you trust them with, and how you check their work

- Your expected monthly rate (full time) and your available hours

title: Google Ads & Performance Max (PMax) Manager
description:
# Google Ads & Performance Max (PMax) Manager



We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Google Ads & Performance Max Manager to manage and grow our ecommerce advertising campaigns.



This is a hands-on position requiring strong analytical skills, excellent communication, and a proven ability to turn advertising spend into profitable sales. You will take ownership of campaign performance, identify opportunities, solve problems, and provide clear updates to company leadership.



You must understand how campaign strategy, product feeds, creative assets, conversion tracking, and website performance work together to drive results.



**Main responsibilities**



- Build, manage, and optimize Google Performance Max campaigns for our ecommerce products.

- Audit existing campaigns and identify wasted spending, tracking issues, and growth opportunities.

- Manage advertising budgets and monitor spending against agreed targets.

- Develop campaign strategies based on product margins, sales performance, inventory availability, and business priorities.

- Manage Google Merchant Center and coordinate the resolution of product disapprovals, feed errors, and account issues.

- Improve product titles, descriptions, images, and other feed information.

- Organize campaigns, asset groups, and product groups to support clear business objectives.

- Coordinate with our creative team to develop and test advertising copy, images, and videos.

- Verify purchase tracking and revenue reporting, working with technical support when needed.

- Analyze return on ad spend, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, and revenue alongside overall business profitability.

- Plan and evaluate tests involving budgets, bidding, creative assets, product selection, and landing pages.

- Manage supporting Google Search and Shopping campaigns where appropriate.

- Coordinate advertising with promotions, product launches, and inventory changes.

- Investigate performance declines and take timely corrective action.

- Maintain organized records of campaign changes, tests, results, and next steps.

- Provide regular performance updates and immediately escalate significant issues.



**Requirements**



- At least three years of hands-on Google Ads experience, including direct management of Performance Max campaigns.

- Proven experience managing ecommerce campaigns with measurable results.

- Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, and product feed management.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and ecommerce conversion tracking.

- Strong understanding of bidding strategies, budget management, attribution, and campaign testing.

- Ability to evaluate advertising performance in the context of product margins and profitability.

- Strong spreadsheet skills and excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to explain what changed, why performance changed, and what action should happen next.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Availability for scheduled calls and urgent account issues during agreed US Eastern Time working hours.

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and follow through without constant supervision.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace.



You must be comfortable joining calls to discuss performance and resolve important issues. Clear, proactive communication is essential.



**Preferred experience**



- Experience growing Google Ads accounts for US-based consumer-products brands.

- Experience with Shopify or other ecommerce platforms.

- Experience managing campaigns across multiple products and product categories.

- Experience with feed-management tools and larger product catalogs.

- Experience with landing-page testing and conversion-rate optimization.

- Experience evaluating new-customer acquisition and distinguishing branded demand from broader growth.

- Experience creating clear performance dashboards in Looker Studio.

- Current Google Ads certifications.



**What success looks like**



- Campaigns meet agreed acquisition-cost and profitability targets.

- Advertising budgets are managed carefully and increased when results justify expansion.

- Purchase and revenue tracking are reliable, and discrepancies are investigated promptly.

- Product feeds remain accurate, with issues identified and resolved quickly.

- Creative and campaign tests produce useful findings that inform future decisions.

- Advertising activity stays aligned with inventory, promotions, and business priorities.

- Problems are identified early and addressed without constant supervision.

- Leadership receives clear updates covering results, actions taken, and next steps.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. Your résumé.

2. A brief description of your Google Ads, Performance Max, and ecommerce experience.

3. Two examples of campaigns you personally managed, including the timeframe, approximate monthly ad spend, starting performance, results, and your specific contribution. You may anonymize client information.

4. Your experience with Google Merchant Center, product feeds, and conversion tracking.

5. Your availability in US Eastern Time.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining one improvement you made to a Performance Max account.

8. The words **“Google PMax Manager”** in your application subject line.



**Applications without a video recording and relevant campaign examples will not be considered.**

- Follow reporting templates and internal processes

- Identify obvious issues or unusual changes in account performance and communicate them to the appropriate team member

- Monitor campaigns to make sure ads are active and delivering properly

- Complete recurring weekly and monthly account checks



You will not be responsible for being the primary paid media strategist. Our paid media team & Founder will handle campaign strategy and optimization decisions.



Graphic Design & Paid Social Support (Not So Often)



- Create static advertising graphics using Canva / Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini

- Resize and adapt existing creative for different placements

- Build graphics based on creative briefs, examples, and brand guidelines

- Upload approved graphics and videos into Meta advertising campaigns

- Assist with launching campaigns after strategy, targeting, copy, and direction have been provided

- Make simple revisions based on feedback



Design fundamentals are a plus, but this is not primarily a graphic designer position.



Organic Social Media Support



- Schedule approved social media content

- Upload finished videos and graphics to client social profiles

- Write or adapt captions based on provided direction and client information

- Make sure posts are formatted correctly for each platform

- Assist with organizing social content and assets



You will generally be working with finished creative produced by our video editing and design team rather than producing advanced video content yourself. You will also either have captions provided to you, or examples provided to work from.



GoHighLevel / CRM & Automation Support



- Create and configure GoHighLevel subaccounts

- Build or duplicate forms, calendars, pipelines, and workflows

- Create simple
 and SMS automations from provided content briefs

- Connect Meta lead forms to GoHighLevel

- Update notification
s, phone numbers, and routing settings

- Test forms and automations to make sure leads are being received correctly

- Customize existing templates for individual clients

- Occasionally troubleshoot basic automation and integration issues



Training and templates will be provided for many of these processes.



Analytics & Conversion Tracking Support



- Create and configure Google Analytics 4 properties

- Create and install Google Tag Manager containers

- Follow our processes & Loom videos for setting up conversion tracking

- Assist with installing Meta Pixels and other tracking scripts

- Connect websites and landing pages to analytics platforms

- Test tracking after setup

- Troubleshoot basic tracking issues using our SOPs and training



You do not need to be an advanced tracking expert. We care more about your ability to understand technology, follow instructions carefully, and troubleshoot when something does not work.



Google Business Profile & Local Marketing Support



- Help create, claim, connect, and optimize Google Business Profiles

- Add services, products, photos, business information, and other profile content

- Assist with review-related tasks and local SEO improvements

- Help troubleshoot basic profile or verification issues

- Complete recurring Google Business Profile updates when assigned



Website & Landing Page Support



Our dedicated web designer handles the majority of website and landing-page development, but you may occasionally help with:



- Minor website edits

- Updating text, images, buttons, links, or forms

- Adding tracking scripts

- Updating landing-page information

- Redirects and URL changes

- Basic on-page SEO tasks

- Website QA and testing

- Supporting our web designer with repetitive implementation tasks



Experience with Duda, WordPress, Shopify, or GoHighLevel websites is helpful, but not required.



General Digital Marketing Support



This is intentionally a broad role.



You may also help with:



- Client onboarding tasks

- Research

- Organizing client files and marketing assets

- Updating spreadsheets

-
 marketing

- Uploading blogs

- Testing forms

- Checking links and tracking

- Creating simple marketing assets

- Following up on technical issues

- Learning and documenting new processes

- Other digital marketing support as needed



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who already understands the basics of digital marketing and technology.



The ideal candidate has:



- Strong written & spoken English

- Previous hands-on digital marketing experience

- Experience with Canva

- Familiarity with Meta/Facebook advertising

- Familiarity with Google Ads

- Basic understanding of GA4 and Google Tag Manager

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM/marketing automation platform

- Basic understanding of websites and landing pages

- Strong attention to detail

- Strong organizational skills

- Ability to manage recurring tasks across multiple clients

- Reliable internet and computer

- Ability to follow SOPs and training videos carefully

- Ability to communicate clearly when something is unclear or going wrong

- Willingness to learn

- Reliable & looking for a long-term role at our company



One of the Most Important Skills: Figure It Out



We don't expect you to know everything.



We **do** expect you to be resourceful.



If something isn't working, we want someone who will investigate the problem, check the SOP, search Google, watch a tutorial, appropriately use AI tools, test possible solutions, and come to the team with what they learned. We are here to train you, but we want you to try to find the solution as well! The team members who have grown the most on our team are strong in this area.



We value people who can say:



"I haven't done this before, but I'll figure out how it works."



rather than immediately stopping at:



"I don't know how to do that."



At the same time, we do not want someone making risky changes to client accounts without asking for help. Knowing when to investigate independently and when to ask is important.



**What This Position Is NOT**



You will **not** be expected to:



- Independently develop overall Google Ads or Meta Ads strategy

- Be the primary person responsible for optimizing paid media accounts

- Build advanced websites from scratch

- Produce video ads

- Independently design complex conversion-tracking architectures

- Manage client relationships or lead strategy calls



We have specialists responsible for those areas.



Your job is to support those specialists and help make sure things actually get implemented correctly.



### Experience



• We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact, so previous digital marketing experience is required.



• You do not need to be an expert in every platform listed above.



• Someone who has worked for another digital marketing agency, managed tasks for multiple client accounts, or worked as a digital marketing VA/support specialist would be a strong fit.



• Experience with several of the following is especially valuable:



• Canva, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, AgencyAnalytics, Google Business Profile, WordPress, Duda, Shopify, SocialBee, Asana



Hours & Compensation



• Starting Rate: $4.50 USD/hour



• Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week



• This is an independent contractor position.



• There is potential for additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation increases as you grow in the position and as Murray Marketing Services continues to grow.



• The schedule is flexible, although we require regular availability Monday through Friday and some working-hour overlap with our U.S.-based team. Typically sometime between 7 am and 7 pm EST.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short Loom introduction about yourself, why you're interested in this role specifically, and your digital marketing experience (REQUIRED)

3. Examples / portfolio of any marketing work you have created

4. The word "MURRAY" at the top of your application so we know you read this.



And please answer the following questions (either written or via Loom):



1. Tell us about your previous digital marketing experience. What did you personally do on a day-to-day basis?



2. Which of the following have you personally used? Rate yourself from 1–5 for each:

 

Canva, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Business Profile, AgencyAnalytics, WordPress/Duda/Shopify.



3. Have you worked inside GoHighLevel? What have you built or managed within it?



4. Imagine you are given a task you've never done before, and there is no exact SOP for it. Walk us through how you would figure it out.



5. How many hours per week are you currently working for other employers or clients? If hired, what hours would you be available for Murray Marketing Services?



6. Why are you interested in this position?

title: VA Disability Claims – Sales & Strategy Call Specialist
description:
Please do not apply if you do not have prior call-handling experience.



Position: Remote (9am to 5pm EDT)

Industry: VA Disability Claims Support



About the Role



We’re looking for a confident, organized, and veteran-focused professional to join our team supporting veterans with their VA disability claims.



This role involves more than making calls. While sales and intake calls are part of the job, the primary responsibility is to conduct strategy calls with veterans, understand their situations, and help confirm which conditions they plan to file based on their current claim strategy and available information.



The ideal candidate communicates clearly, listens well, and can guide veterans through conversations with confidence and empathy.



Key Responsibilities



1. Strategy Calls – 



Conduct strategy calls with veterans to review and confirm which conditions they plan to file.



Discuss their current claim situation, supporting documentation, and next steps.



Conduct document intake calls to identify what records and information are needed.



Accurately document call notes, decisions, and action items in the CRM.



Coordinate with the internal team to ensure veterans receive the appropriate follow-up and support.



2. Sales & Intake Calls – 



Conduct sales calls with prospective clients to explain our services and guide them through the intake process.



Clearly communicate the value of our VA disability claims support services.



Ask the right questions to understand each veteran’s needs and determine whether our services are a good fit.



Follow up with prospective clients and maintain accurate records of conversations.



Qualifications



Strong verbal communication skills and confidence leading calls.



Experience in sales, intake, client success, case management, or a similar role.



Experience with VA disability claims is a strong advantage.



Familiarity with VA disability benefits, claim processes, and supporting medical documentation is preferred.



Excellent listening, organizational, and documentation skills.



Ability to explain information clearly and professionally to veterans.



Comfortable using CRMs and online tools to track conversations and follow-ups.



Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for calls.







How to Apply



As part of your application, please submit a short Vocaroo voice recording introducing yourself and sharing your relevant work experience.



Please include:



A brief introduction about yourself.



Your experience with sales calls, strategy calls, intake, or client-facing roles.



Any experience with VA disability claims or working with veterans.



Why you believe you would be a good fit for this role.



We’re looking for someone who can do more than follow a script—someone who can lead meaningful conversations, keep veterans’ cases organized, and help them move forward with clarity and confidence.

title: Accountant *DIRECT HIRE*
description:
Accountant (Remote, Outsourced Client Accounting)



Two things before you apply:



1. You must be able to work a CST schedule.

2. You must have real accounting experience.



About the Role

We are an outsourced accounting firm looking for a sharp, dependable Accountant to own AR, AP, and month-end work across a portfolio of clients. You will run the full transactional cycle and the reconciliations that close the books, not just data entry. If you like clean numbers, tight deadlines, and clients who count on you, you will fit here.



This is a client-facing role in a fast-paced environment. We hire people with strong judgment, clear communication, and the integrity to flag a problem instead of burying it.



What You’ll Own



Accounts Receivable



• Generate and send client invoices

• Post cash receipts and apply credit card payments accurately

• Run collections follow-up and track outstanding balances

• Maintain AR aging and escalate issues early



Accounts Payable



• Code and post vendor invoices to the right accounts and periods

• Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies

• Prepare and execute payment runs (checks, ACH, wires)

• Chase down missing bills from clients and vendors

• Keep job completion entries accurate



Month-End Close



• Complete bank and credit card reconciliations

• Run Syncore bank recs and support month-end close in Syncore

• Reconcile client QuickBooks data against Syncore

• Investigate and resolve cross-system variances

• Post general ledger adjustments and journal entries



As part of our team, you'll enjoy:

• Stable, long-term employment with a growing organization.

• Direct exposure to U.S.-based clients, allowing you to develop valuable client-facing and professional communication skills.

• Career growth opportunities as the company continues to expand.

• A collaborative and supportive team environment where knowledge sharing and teamwork are encouraged.

• Performance-based compensation reviews that recognize strong contributions and consistent results.

• Training and professional development opportunities to help you build your skills and advance your career.



We are looking for team members who are committed to excellence, eager to learn, and interested in building a long-term career with us.



How to Apply

Record a short video answering these three questions:



1. What are the top two strengths every virtual accountant should have?

2. How do you prioritize when you are juggling multiple clients and competing deadlines?

3. Tell me about a real challenge you have faced as an accountant and how you handled it.



Include links to both your video and your resume in your cover letter.

title: Social Media Content Strategist & Marketing VA
description:
Company: The Pod Place

Location: Remote

Position: Part-Time (Potential to Grow)

Hours: Approximately 20 hours/week to start with room to grow.



ABOUT US



The Pod Place is a growing podcast studio company with locations in Las Vegas and Los Angeles. We help entrepreneurs, business owners, and content creators produce professional podcasts and video content without the technical hassle.



We're looking for a creative, marketing-savvy, and highly organized Social Media Content Strategist & Marketing Virtual Assistant to help us grow our brand through video-first social media content, ad creative,
 marketing, and other marketing initiatives.







IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT ROLE.



We're NOT looking for someone whose social media experience consists primarily of making Canva graphics, writing generic captions, and scheduling posts.



We're looking for someone who understands how to BUILD and GROW a brand through social media.



You should understand:



What makes short-form videos perform well.

How to identify viral and outlier content.

How to analyze successful content formats and adapt them to a different brand.

How to write compelling hooks and create engaging video concepts.

How to turn existing footage into engaging social media content.

How to use AI tools to streamline content creation, marketing, and research.

We're looking for someone who can bring ideas to the table, not just wait for instructions.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Social Media Content Strategy & Creation ⭐ TOP PRIORITY



You'll be responsible for researching, planning, and helping execute approximately 12 pieces of social media content per week for The Pod Place.



- Content Research & Strategy

- Research high-performing Reels, TikToks, and other short-form video content.

- Identify outlier content that significantly outperforms an account's typical engagement.

- Analyze WHY specific videos perform well, including hooks, storytelling, pacing, visuals, and format.

- Adapt proven content formats into original ideas relevant to our brand.

- Develop approximately 12 content concepts weekly, including hooks, scripts, filming directions, and creative references.

- Maintain an organized content calendar.

- Content Creation & Editing

- We have existing footage, brand assets, and video editors available.



Depending on the content concept, you'll either:



A. Create the content yourself

Repurpose our existing footage into short-form videos.

Create simple edits using CapCut, Instagram Edits, or AI editing tools.

Add text overlays, captions, music, and basic transitions.

Prepare finished content for our team's approval.

Schedule and publish approved content.



B. Prepare content for our filming/editing team

Write hooks, scripts, or talking points.

Provide clear filming instructions and shot lists.

Share examples and references.

Coordinate with our team to get content filmed.

Prepare editing briefs for our video editors when more advanced editing is needed.



Weekly Workflow

Every Monday, we expect:

Approximately 12 new content concepts for the upcoming production cycle.

The previous week's content prepared for review, with simple edits completed and more complex edits coordinated with our editors.

An updated content calendar.

Approved content scheduled for consistent publishing throughout the week.



The goal is to stay ahead of our publishing schedule, maintain a consistent flow of fresh content, and continuously improve performance.



2. Ad Creative Iterations ⭐ TOP PRIORITY



We run paid social media ads and want to consistently test new creative variations of our winning advertisements.

You'll be responsible for creating approximately 5 new ad creative variations per week based on proven messaging and successful ad angles.



This includes:

Taking existing winning ad scripts and adapting them into different formats.

Creating simple video ads using existing footage.

Turning video scripts into static graphics, carousels, or text-based videos.

Testing alternative hooks, visuals, and creative approaches.

Using AI tools to efficiently produce creative variations.

Organizing completed ad creatives for review and testing.

We will provide the winning messaging and ad angles.

Your job is to creatively repackage that messaging into different formats so we can continuously test new ads.



Bonus: Experience analyzing Meta Ads performance and preparing simple weekly creative performance reports.



SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES



These tasks are important and must be completed consistently, but social media content and ad creative remain the top priorities.



3. Weekly
 Newsletters

Draft and schedule one
 newsletter per week.

Repurpose existing content, podcast episodes, company updates, and educational material into engaging
s.

Write compelling subject lines and calls to action.

Use AI tools to assist with research, writing, and content repurposing.

Maintain our brand voice and ensure newsletters are sent consistently.



4. Skool Community Management

Create and schedule community posts each week.

Share educational content, discussion prompts, announcements, and training reminders.

title: Video Editor — DaVinci Resolve | Premium Residential Projects & Reels
description:
Part-time | Remote | Ongoing work | Potential to grow into full-time



We’re an Australian photography and videography studio creating content for builders, architects, pool builders, landscapers and specialist trades working on high-end residential projects.



We’re looking for a reliable video editor with strong visual judgement, thoughtful storytelling and attention to detail.



Our work showcases design and craftsmanship through portfolio films, award submissions, completed-project videos and social media content. This role focuses on showcasing our clients’ work and businesses rather than conventional real-estate sales videos.





WHAT YOU’LL BE EDITING



Completed-project films and reels:

Refined, intentional edits showcasing finished homes, pools, gardens and outdoor spaces. These pieces highlight design, materials, workmanship, and the overall feeling of a project.



Construction-progress content:

Shorter, more energetic reels featuring tradespeople, processes, materials, machinery, and projects taking shape.



You should be comfortable adapting the pace and approach to each project while maintaining a consistent level of quality.





THE STYLE WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Thoughtful shot selection and sequencing, with a clear sense of flow.

• Calm, considered pacing that gives strong visuals room to breathe.

• A balance of wider project views and close-up details.

• Natural, consistent colour that preserves the character of materials and light.

• Carefully chosen music, ambient sound and subtle sound design.

• Clean cuts and purposeful transitions.

• The ability to create engaging, faster-paced reels when the brief calls for it.

• Good judgement about when to use effects, speed ramps and graphics.





ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



• Confident editing and colour grading in DaVinci Resolve Studio.

• Experience working with log footage, including Sony S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine and DJI Mavic 3 D-Log.

• Ability to colour-match ground and aerial footage for a consistent finish.

• Understanding of frame rates, slow motion and delivery formats.

• Ability to create both horizontal videos and vertical reels.

• Comfortable working with proxies, relinking original footage and handing over organised Resolve projects.

• Strong judgement around pacing, music selection and sound design.

• Ability to follow a brief, ask useful questions and apply feedback.

• Clear communication, dependable turnaround and attention to deadlines.

• Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling the editing workflow.



Experience with premium residential, architecture, landscaping, interiors or property content is helpful. We also welcome experience in brand films, hospitality, lifestyle or other work that demonstrates strong visual judgement.



Photo editing, Fusion and motion graphics are welcome bonuses, but they are not the main focus of this role.





HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject line:

Video Editor — Premium Residential Content



Include the following in your application:



1. Two or three relevant video examples.

Explain what you personally handled on each, such as editing, colour grading or sound design. Please make sure the links are accessible.



2. Your DaVinci Resolve experience.

Tell us which version you use and whether you have Studio. Include a timeline screenshot or short screen recording from a project you’re permitted to share.



3. Your relevant experience.

Briefly describe the types of content you’ve edited and why you feel suited to this role.



4. Your availability.

Include your current work commitments, realistic hours available each week, usual working hours in Australian time, and earliest start date.



5. Your rate.

State your expected hourly rate and currency.



6. Your interest in ongoing work.

Let us know whether you’re looking for a long-term role and would be open to increasing your hours over time.



We’re looking for someone who cares about the details, communicates clearly and takes pride in the finished work.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Position Overview:

We're looking for a strong, self-directed Accounting Manager to own the full financial operations of two service companies under one parent LLC. This is not a data-entry role. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate every day, making sure payroll and payroll taxes are handled correctly, tracking our debt obligations, and giving the Owner a clear picture of profitability and cash flow. The right person spots problems before they become problems and works without being told what to do next. This role reports directly to the Owner.



Key Responsibilities:



Daily Bookkeeping & Reconciliation



Reconcile all bank and credit card accounts daily using QuickBooks bank feeds, and categorize transactions accurately.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies the same day they appear.

Maintain clean, separate books for two entities.



Payroll & Payroll Taxes



Process weekly/bi-weekly payroll accurately and on schedule.

Calculate, file, and pay US payroll taxes on time, including federal withholding, FICA, FUTA (Form 940), quarterly Form 941, NC state withholding, and NC unemployment.

Maintain payroll tax deposit schedules and make sure there are zero late filings or penalties.



Job Profitability



Track and report profitability by job, service type, and client for both residential and commercial services.

Analyze labor, supply, and overhead costs against job revenue, and flag underperforming jobs or pricing issues to the Owner.



Cash Flow Forecasting



Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast.

Project upcoming obligations (payroll, taxes, loan remittances, vendor bills) and alert the Owner to potential shortfalls in advance.



Debt & Financing Management



Properly record and track merchant cash advances (MCAs) and Stripe Capital loans, including the original balance, fees/factor rates, and daily or weekly remittances.

Reconcile loan balances to lender statements and maintain an accurate payoff schedule for every financing obligation.



AP, AR & Reporting



Manage accounts receivable, monitor due dates, and follow up on outstanding invoices.

Process accounts payable on time or ahead of schedule, and maintain an organized vendor and approval system.

Complete month-end close and deliver monthly financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with a written summary for the Owner.

Assist with budgeting and expense management.

Coordinate with our CPA for quarterly and annual filings.



Qualifications:



5+ years of experience in accounting or bookkeeping, including managing books independently.

Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks, including bank feeds, rules, classes, and reporting.

Proven working knowledge of US federal and state payroll tax calculation, filing, and deposits.

Experience tracking business loans and financing, with MCA and/or Stripe Capital experience strongly preferred.

Experience building cash flow forecasts and job-costing or profitability reports.

Ability to work independently, manage your own deadlines, and bring solutions rather than questions.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

High integrity with confidential financial information.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.



Preferred Skills:



Experience in service-based businesses, especially cleaning, home services, or field service.

Multi-entity bookkeeping experience.

Familiarity with Profit First.

Experience working on an EOS team (Scorecards, Rocks).

This is a part-time remote position — 20 hours per week — with a competitive hourly rate based on experience. You will have a clear content calendar, real campaign budgets to work with, and an owner who is invested in marketing performing well. For the right person, this role has room to grow.



Our Culture
